pages.text: This is a world for a small group of friends. Pick a folk, pick a calling, learn a trade, and push from the Overworld into the Nether and finally the End.$(br2)The quest book ($(k:key.ftbquests.quests)) tells you what to try next and pays you for it. This handbook explains how things work.
Lost your handbook? A book and a feather make a new one.
